mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT ID AS id, TABLE_NAME AS tableName, TABLE_COMMENT AS tableComment, QUERY_TIME AS queryTime, CATEGORY AS category, SORT_ORDER AS sortOrder FROM REDACTED.TBL_TABLE_QUERY_HISTORY WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY CATEGORY, SORT_ORDER, QUERY_TIME DESC
mapper.insert: MERGE INTO REDACTED.TBL_TABLE_QUERY_HISTORY t USING ( SELECT #{userId} AS USER_ID, #{tableName} AS TABLE_NAME FROM DUAL ) s ON (t.USER_ID = s.USER_ID AND t.TABLE_NAME = s.TABLE_NAME) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET t.QUERY_TIME = SYSDATE, t.TABLE_COMMENT = #{tableComment} WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (ID, USER_ID, TABLE_NAME, TABLE_COMMENT, QUERY_TIME, CATEGORY, SORT_ORDER) VALUES (#{userId} || '_' || #{tableName}, #{userId}, #{tableName}, #{tableComment}, SYSDATE, '未分类', 0)
